dogecoin.text: #HappyLaborDayWeekend everyone! My #Blog https://t.co/URL6bmY1z9 has a #crypto update. The bulls are returning, but slowly. #Dogecoin almost went parabolic! So many are talking about #Grande at Aretha's funeral. Yes, the #swamp remains for now.

@nathanwosnack @ubitquity_io @equibit I lost a LOT of sleep that Spring '13 when watching Bitcoin rebound from nowhere. I used some of my tax refund to buy over 16 BTC. Gambled some, earn more back via #Dogecoin (1st day shiebe) Educated and enlightened me that no school could've done. I even avoided getting Goxxed.
This first-day Shiebe (I accepted Doge on it's first day, 12/8/13) would happily accept #Dogecoin as a refund method. It's treated me well in the past. Such W0W, Much C0!N, Way tail-wags.
